name: Fleet
tagline: Provides an online web interface which displays a set of maintained images from one or more owned repositories.
description: Fleet provides an online web interface which displays a set of maintained images from one or more owned repositories.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/fleet:2.3.3@sha256:6a0c946a9339b848a5f31d06ff45876dd94fee8cc19b1f8b6a8b0b60e3bbff24
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      fleet_admin_authentication_type: ''
      fleet_database_url: ''
      fleet_database_username: ''
      fleet_database_password: ''
      fleet_admin_secret: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
